 Gui Santos (knee) questionable Monday 
 by Nicholas Rodriguez | Warriors Correspondent | Mon, Oct 26th 2026, 10:33am EDT 
 Gui Santos is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Denver Nuggets. ( NBA Injury Report ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Santos was limited to 23 minutes in Saturday's 131-122 loss to the Phoenix Suns after sustaining a knee injury and is now questionable for Monday's contest due to left knee tendinitis. If he's unable to play, Georges Niang and Gary Payton II could see increased minutes.
